# Clavio
Companion workflow for [Clavio](https://clavioapp.com) — AI hands-free dictation that adapts to every app (macOS 14.2+, Apple Silicon).
## Usage
Type `clavio` to:
- **Open Clavio** — launches the app, or opens the download page if it isn't installed (free tier: 3,000 words/month, no card) - **Download Clavio** / **Changelog** - **Search 28 dictation guides** — voice typing, punctuation commands, per-app dictation (Slack, Word, ChatGPT…), troubleshooting
No dependencies, nothing to configure. Requires Alfred Powerpack. The workflow itself is free; Clavio offers separate Free and Pro plans. Transcription and text polishing require internet access.
